verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents creating branded, compliant invoices and matching invoices to bank payments, which shows paid status through reconciliation, and it can send dunning notices for overdue invoices. The evidence never mentions customer-facing online payment options or tracking when an invoice is viewed. Its bank integration is for paying your own bills, not for collecting payment. missing for 10: online payment options/pay links on invoices, invoice-viewed tracking, explicit documentation of emailing invoices, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: You create quotes and invoices in your own design fulfilling all mandatory information.
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
Create a dunning notice for an overdue invoice and send it directly from sevdesk.
